mugen_integration.cause: trace_buf __at(0xC800) overlapped tl_snap 0xC800-0xC810, frame_cache_storage 0xC810-0xC86C, pose_runtime_cache 0xC900-0xC930 (map confirmed before change)
mugen_integration.solution: trace_buf relocated to 0xD200-0xDA00 (diagnostic clone only; canonical ROM untouched); 8-byte 0xA5 guard at 0xDA00 between trace and stack; capacity unchanged (170 records x 12 B + 8 B header); no cache removed
mugen_integration.budget: DATA 0xC000-0xC79A; absolutes 0xC7A0-0xC930; sat_y/sat_xt 0xD000-0xD0D8; tmpl 0xD100-0xD1F0; trace 0xD200-0xDA00; guard 0xDA00-0xDA08; stack SP 0xDFF0 => >=1.5 KB reserve (call depth not measured)
mugen_integration.gate: check_ram_layout runs before the emulator; runtime verifies magic/header, count==170, rec size and guard bytes before accepting the trace
mugen_integration.demonstrated: idle, soco, soco_p2 produced 170 ticks in concurrent private sessions; soco moves only P1 state, soco_p2 only P2; guard intact
mugen_integration.limits: stack depth not measured; guard detects only overruns that reach 0xDA00; trace proves fight state, not render/SAT
